return [{ json: { email_domain: s.normalized.email_domain } }];

const s = $input.first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    airtable_record_id: s.recordId,
    run_id: s.run_id,
    processing_started_at: s.processing_started_at,

    input: {
      first_name: s.input.first_name,
      last_name: s.input.last_name,
    },

    email: s.email,
    email_domain: s.email_domain,
    email_local: s.email_local,

    domain_status: s.domain_status,
    is_personal_domain: s.is_personal_domain,
    is_role_inbox: s.is_role_inbox,
    is_system_inbox: s.is_system_inbox,

    name_quality: s.name_quality,
    name_quality_reason: s.name_quality_reason,
    supplied_name: s.supplied_name,

    domain_verification_status: s.domain_verification_status,
    domain_verification_reason: s.domain_verification_reason,

    enrichment_status: "processing",
    result_status: "pending",
    manual_review: false,
    manual_review_reason: null,
    routing_outcome: null
  }
}];
